name: New York City adopted rules, selected Local Laws and historical Code and Charter snapshots
coverage: 462 adopted-rule instruments, selected numbered enacted Local Laws, 6,106 Administrative Code sections and 627 Charter sections in historical 2017 source snapshots
record_note: Rules and Local Laws are separate enacted instruments. The Local Law collection is incomplete for the period since 2017-04-22. Historical Code and Charter snapshots are not updated by replay; their exact legal currency is unknown. The record_to day is a source assessment day, not a claim of complete Local Law coverage.
